convention.in_place: every clip keeps the root still; the game moves the body. Loops: first frame == last frame.
convention.sockets_axis: each socket's local +Z points out of it (muzzle: along the bore; eye/visor: out of the face)

skeleton.naming: Quaternius universal rig (root pelvis spine_01..03 neck_01 Head clavicle/upperarm/lowerarm/hand _l/_r, thigh/calf/foot/ball _l/_r, fingers)

Attack.source: UAL2 Sword_Regular_A + Sword_Regular_B (joined over 3 frames) + Sword_Regular_B_Rec eased back onto Idle t=0
Attack.note: two cuts: UAL2 Sword_Regular_A then Sword_Regular_B (joined over 3 frames), then Sword_Regular_B_Rec eased onto Idle t=0 by 1.7 s. 'contacts' = where the blade tip moves fastest in each cut

Death.source: authored: the power cuts out, the head snaps back, the knees fold and it drops onto them, then pitches face down onto the street and lies crumpled, arms out; one servo twitch at 1.33 s
Death.note: authored: the power cuts, the head snaps back, the knees fold and it drops onto them, pitches face down and lies crumpled on the street with its arms out; one last servo twitch at 1.33 s; holds from 1.0 s

Idle.source: UAL1 Sword_Idle raised 6 cm out of its crouch (feet planted by IK), fists closed, a quick robotic glance at 0.5-1.2 s
Idle.note: UAL1 Sword_Idle raised 6 cm out of its crouch (feet held by IK): blade hand low and forward, left fist up; a quick robotic glance to the side at 0.5-1.2 s; loops

Lunge.source: UAL2 Sword_Dash: drops low, drives forward and thrusts the blade, recovers onto Idle t=0
Lunge.note: UAL2 Sword_Dash: drops low, drives forward, thrusts the blade at 'contact'; eases onto Idle t=0 at the end. The body motion is in place: city-enemies.js moves the root (lungeTravel) during the strike

Run.source: UAL1 Jog_Fwd_Loop, arms 30% toward the guard, head up
Run.speed_note: natural ground speed (median slide of the planted foot); play at stride/speed_mps for planted feet
Run.note: UAL1 Jog_Fwd_Loop, arms 30% toward the guard, head up; dropped 4.8 cm so the feet land

Walk.source: UAL1 Walk_Loop, arms 55% toward the guard (a stalk)
Walk.speed_note: natural ground speed (median slide of the planted foot); play at stride/speed_mps for planted feet
Walk.note: UAL1 Walk_Loop, arms held 55% toward the guard: a stalk

weapon_grip.purpose: the blade's root over the back of the right wrist, child of hand_r; grip->tip is the blade for sweeps and trails

weapon_tip.purpose: the blade's point (0.4 m past the knuckles), child of hand_r; +Z along the blade. Every cut and the lunge hit with this blade

eye.purpose: centre of the cyan eye slit, child of Head; +Z out of the face

materials.chrome_armor_mat: baked 2048 atlas (JPEG): baseColor, ORM (R occlusion, G roughness, B metalness), tangent normal. Chrome plates: metalness 1, base colour at real chrome reflectance (linear ~0.6, nothing painted in), roughness ~0.06-0.15 with faint smudges; dark chrome bands (base 0.1, roughness ~0.2); black glass visor band; dark ribbed rubber joints (metalness 0.15, roughness ~0.4). In the city it reads as a black mirror carrying the neon; for the brighter silver of Alex's frame give this material envMap = the city environment and envMapIntensity ~1.0 (three r180 uses scene.environmentIntensity 0.5 when a material has no envMap of its own)
materials.chrome_eye: untextured emissive cyan (linear 0.22, 0.85, 1.0), KHR_materials_emissive_strength 6: the eye slit, the sternum seam light, a line along each forearm and the blade's edge. city-enemies.js drives it as the tell

summary: Chrome humanoid android: polished mirror plates with real gaps over dark ribbed joints, an ovoid head with a black glass visor band and a cyan eye slit, a few cyan seam lights, a blade on the back of the right hand. One skinned mesh: baked atlas + one emissive glow material.
